name: Star Wars: Clone Wars
description: During the Clone Wars, Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi leads an assault on the planet Muunilinst, home of the Intergalactic Banking Clan; and his Padawan, Anakin Skywalker, is appointed by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine to lead the Republic’s space forces. Meanwhile, Separatist leader and Sith Lord Count Dooku takes in Force-sensitive gladiator Asajj Ventress as his Sith apprentice, and tasks her with eliminating Skywalker.

videos.title: Star Wars: Clone Wars, Volume One (2005)
videos.overview:
Chapters 1-20

Follow the valiant Jedi Knights and the brave soldiers of the Republic's clone army as they battle the droid forces of the Separatists, led by the evil Sith Lord, Count Dooku. Witness the battles that made galactic heroes out of Anakin Skywalker and Obi-Wan Kenobi, along the way get a first look at the new menace from Episode III, General Grievous.

videos.title: Star Wars: Clone Wars, Volume Two (2005)
videos.overview:
Chapters 21-25

Witness first-hand the trials of Anakin Skywalker and the secret ceremony in which he becomes a Jedi Knight. Then, follow the Jedi as they attempt to repel a surprise attack by General Grievous on the galactic capital, Coruscant. Clone Wars Volume Two is filled with exciting battles that lead directly to the beginning of Revenge of the Sith.

videos.title: Clone Wars: Bridging the Saga
videos.overview: A short documentary on the making of the Cartoon Network's Clone Wars micro series, specifically the final 5 episodes.

videos.title: Clone Wars: Connecting the Dots
videos.overview: A look at how the final batch of Star Wars: Clone Wars (2003) episodes segue into Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith (2005) by the writers and producers of the cartoon series.

videos.title: Behind the Scenes
videos.overview: Behind-the-scenes featurette from the Volume I DVD

videos.title: Chapter 1
videos.overview: Three months after the battle of Geonosis, the Clone Wars rage across the galaxy. Obi-Wan Kenobi is given the task of leading the assault on Muunilinst while Anakin Skywalker gets command over the space forces. Anakin bids farewell to his secret wife, senator Amidala.

videos.title: Chapter 2
videos.overview: Obi-Wan's elite ARC Troopers are shot down over the capitol of Muunilinst as the assault on the Banking Clan's home planet begins.

videos.title: Chapter 3
videos.overview: Pinned down by droid enemy fire, the ARC troopers must make use of their specialist training to reach their target.

videos.title: Chapter 4
videos.overview: With the battle of Muunilinst raging in space as well as on land, San Hill orders Durge and his IG-lancer droids to defend the city.

videos.title: Chapter 5
videos.overview: On Mon Calamari, Kit Fisto and his Scuba Troopers defends the Calamari council against Manta Droid sub fighters army of the Quarren Isolation league. Mon Calamari Knights riding giant Keelkana's provide the Republic forces with back up.

videos.title: Chapter 6
videos.overview: Count Dooku arrives on Rattatak to witness the gladiator fights at the "Cauldron". A force sensitive woman beats every opponent in the Arena and claims to be a Sith.

videos.title: Chapter 7
videos.overview: Dooku submits Assaij Ventress to a test with the lightsaber before sending her on her way to find and eliminate Anakin Skywalker.

videos.title: Chapter 8
videos.overview: General Kenobi and his troopers mount up on speeder bikes to take on Bounty Hunter Durge and the droid forces from the InterGalactic Banking Clan.

videos.title: Chapter 9
videos.overview: General Kenobi and the ARC Troopers capture the Banking Clan's headquarters but Durge remains in pursuit, displaying almost unstoppable regenerative powers.

videos.title: Chapter 10
videos.overview: Anakin once again proves himself to be the best star fighter in the galaxy battling Geonosian fighters above Muunilinst.

videos.title: Chapter 11
videos.overview: Anakin chases a mysterious rogue pilot (Asajj Ventress) piloting a Geonosian Fanblade Starfighter and against his masters orders, pursues her into hyperspace.

videos.title: Chapter 12
videos.overview: Young Paxi Sylo looks on as Mace Windu battles Seperatist droids backed up by enormous seismic tanks on Dantooine.

videos.title: Chapter 13
videos.overview: Having lost his lightsaber, Master Windu takes on a battalion of Super Battle Droids hand to hand.

videos.title: Chapter 14
videos.overview: The sacred Jedi temple on Ilum is attacked by Chameleon droids just as Luminara Unduli's Padawan, Barriss Offee is completing her training.

videos.title: Chapter 15
videos.overview: Master Yoda, traveling aboard Senator Amidala's ship, persuades Captain Typho to take a detour to Ilum in order to mount a rescue operation.

videos.title: Chapter 16
videos.overview: Padme, worrying about Master Yoda, is attacked by Chameleon Droids. Luckily she has Threepio to use as a shooting target.

videos.title: Chapter 17
videos.overview: Anakin has followed Asaij Ventress to Yavin VI. Although a Clone squadron has been sent after them by Obi-Wan in a Republic carrier, they prove to be no match for the Sith hopeful.

videos.title: Chapter 18
videos.overview: Ventress leads Anakin trough the jungles of Yavin VI towards the ancient Massassi Temples once inhabited by Exar Kun.

videos.title: Chapter 19
videos.overview: Driven to the edge by Asaij Ventress, Anakin almost gives in to the dark side in a final bid to defeat her.

videos.title: Chapter 20
videos.overview: The Republic has won the battle of Muunilist, but news arrives of a new droid general hunting down Jedi on the planet Hypori. There, a group of Jedi consisting of Ki-Adi Mundi, Shaak Ti, K'Kruhk, Aayla Secura, Tarr Seirr and Sha'A Gi are driven into a corner by the formidable General Grievous.

videos.title: Chapter 21
videos.overview: Captain Fordo and his ARC troopers rescue Ki Adi Mundi, Aayla Secura and Shaak Ti from Grievous but leave K'Kruhk for dead. The Jedi council grants Anakin Skywalker the title of Jedi Knight, after which Senator Amidala allows him the use of R2D2 as co-pilot for his Jedi Interceptor.

videos.title: Chapter 22
videos.overview: Leading the third army of the Republic, General Kenobi and Commander Skywalker blow up a shield generator on Bomis Korri IV. Meanwhile, Seperatist forces move in on Outer Rim planets such as Kashyyk, Orto and Bal'demnic. As Darth Sidious launches his final operation, Obi-Wan and Anakin are send to Nilvaan, where young Skywalker disrupts a young native's right of passage by defeating a giant Horax.

videos.title: Chapter 23
videos.overview: Coruscant is attacked by Seperatists forces. Mace Windu takes to the air while Yoda rides his Kybuck to defend the city. Meanwhile Saesee Tinn leads his troops into battle just above the planet's atmosphere. On Nilvaan, Obi-Wan volunteers Anakin to take the trial of fire.

videos.title: Chapter 24
videos.overview: Jedi Shaak Ti, Roron Corobb and Foul Moudama fight to keep Supreme Chancelor Palpatine out of General Grievous mechanical claws. Anakin finds a hidden laboratory where the Techno Union is conducting mutation experiments on Nelvaan warriors.

videos.title: Chapter 25
videos.overview: Shaak Ti takes a desperate stand against Grievous' Magnaguards. Anakin, surrounded by mutated Nelvaan Warriors, must destroy the geothermal crystal powering the siphon generator. Mace Windu hurries to face General Grievous. This episode's end marks the beginning of Episode III: Revenge of the Sith.

awards: Won 3 Primetime Emmys. 4 wins & 3 nominations total
